Ordinary decimal strings retain exact trim/decimal/type/range predicates. Number-like conversion failure occurs before later string/number type rejection where required by the frozen Source helper. Settings persist through the existing nonsecret setting map; environment/file/default precedence, inactive reporting and edit validation remain. MIN is not an organization-policy lock. native_api_migration.nan_input: JSON-backed Value/JsDocument configuration inputs cannot admit raw NaN. Invalid JSON rejection, a null projection or raw Infinity are not execution of a native NaN numeric guard. Source raw JavaScript NaN observations remain a distinct input interface.
native_api_migration.manual_public_field: RouterConfig::min_confidence is public f64 and CAN contain NaN, Infinity or an invalid range after direct mutation. This review gives direct mutation no parsed-setting validation guarantee. Use the configuration reader; do not claim every native configuration API excludes NaN.
native_api_migration.root_resource_decision: For invalid nonnumeric JSON settings, accept host resource-exhaustion diagnostic divergence between native iterative conversion and recursive JavaScript array conversion. Ordinary conversion/type/range/error precedence and rejection remain required. No valid numeric/string setting is made invalid, no arrays/objects become numeric settings, and no supported-input depth ceiling is introduced.
native_api_migration.resource_nonclaims: No V8-specific universal stack threshold, allocation-failure identity, actual extreme-depth RangeError reproduction, all-depth error fidelity or zero-allocation guarantee. Passing finite64/256 controls does not prove those properties. This is an explicit native embedding migration, not a silent waiver of ordinary error contracts.
native_api_migration.other_js_interfaces: Live getters, custom prototypes, error identities and mutable object aliases are not represented by the JSON-backed input API. Original config and router-alias assertion mappings remain unchanged; no whole-definition approval follows.
